summary: Implemented ADM-25 and ADM-26 article and category administration with strict runtime API adapters, CRUD/editor/review controls, server-backed article and category filters, localized desktop states, and safe projections.

verification.notes: Web TypeScript compiled with the strict article/category query contracts.
Web source and tests passed ESLint with zero warnings.
Focused suite passed 7 tests, including article status/search and category search query propagation.
12 desktop Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese functional/accessibility cases passed; 24 tablet/mobile projects skipped by the approved desktop scope.
Three desktop locale visual cases passed; six non-desktop projects skipped by the approved desktop scope.
42 Vitest files and 282 tests passed, plus 76 TAP tests.
Root contracts, API, and web typecheck passed.
Root workspace check and lint passed.
Root workspace checks, API suite, web suite, and TAP suite passed.
Contracts, API, client, and SSR builds passed.
All eight admin article/category operations are implemented, including list, CRUD, and transition routes.
No whitespace errors in the task-scoped changes.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors.

Runtime routes: GET/POST/PATCH /api/v1/admin/articles, POST /api/v1/admin/articles/:articleId/transitions, GET/POST /api/v1/admin/article-categories, PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/admin/article-categories/:categoryId.
API inventory, OpenAPI, and Postman validation confirm the article/category route set is implemented and synchronized.
Focused unit tests verify strict request schemas, authorization headers, safe projections, reason-bearing mutations, and server-backed filter queries.
Desktop Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese Playwright functional, accessibility, and visual evidence passed for ADM-25 and ADM-26.
scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified as the necessary route-composition exception for /admin/articles and /admin/article-categories.
The admin dashboard approved device scope is desktop; tablet and mobile Playwright projects were skipped accordingly.
The three category visual baselines were regenerated after the approved category search control became server-backed; the final no-update visual rerun passed.
